title: Standard Chartered to expand institutional crypto and RWA custody to Singapore
reason: Major global bank expanding institutional crypto custody to a new jurisdiction, corroborated by three sources.

sources.summary: The bank would offer the service to institutions and accredited corporate investors, subject to regulatory requirements.
Standard Chartered plans custody for cryptocurrencies, stablecoins and tokenized assets for institutional and eligible corporate clients in Singapore.
The bank said the service would extend its existing crypto custody footprint in the UAE, Luxembourg, and Hong Kong.

title: Top Democrat among Senate investigators probes ties between Cantor Fitzgerald, Tether
reason: Named senator probing the Tether-Cantor Fitzgerald partnership is significant regulatory scrutiny with two independent sources.

sources.summary: As Democrats steadily rise in their potential to take back a Senate majority, Senator Richard Blumenthal is digging into Tether's U.S. financial partnership.
The letter follows a report by the Democratic investigators last month alleging Tether’s USDT has become a key tool for Iran’s shadow banking network.
